answer_1.quote: We formalize the Entailment-Preserving FOL representations (EPF) task, where one must produce FOL representations that preserve the entailment in multi-premise RTE datasets.
answer_1.outputs: First-order logic (FOL) representations from natural language sentences

answer_2.quote: We develop a suite of reference-free metrics, the Entailment-Preserving Rate (EPR) family, for evaluating performance in EPF.
